title: Which AI tool creates the most viral gaming clips in your experience?
author: seowithumang
selftext:
I’ve been trying to scale up my gaming channel but posting daily shorts manually is a massive pain. Tried streamladder for a couple of weeks to automate things. It was okay but it kept missing my clutch plays if the audio chat was quiet. Switched over to WayinVideo after seeing some clip channels recommend it on discord. The AI visual detection is honestly on another level compared to standard clippers. It actually tracks the action on screen so it knows exactly when the hype moments happen based on the game itself.   
  
My retention metrics on shorts have definitely gone up since switching over. What tool are you guys using to find the best hooks? Anyone else noticed the algorithm favoring specific caption styles lately?

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
hey my guy best advice would really be to study a streamer or content creator who has the success you'd like to reach and see what consistent things they have. it may be a type of font, the color of font, the placement, the split of the grid of the video, the intro and the timestamp where they cut.

It's always something. you have to figure out what yours is. It can work and when it does itll go crazy. Keep trying as many new ways as possible. But key word. **NEW....** EVEN if its just the title or the thumbnail. These A/B Testings are what make the difference sometimes

  
just my 2 cents
